messages:
maya: quick check — can we shift the cross-functional roadmap sync from Tue 11am to Thu 9am PT for the next two weeks? design review and infra interview both collide. need to lock agenda owners for a few items.

maya: items to cover (proposed):
- 20m: rollout gating doc (prod + infra)
- 15m: infra autoscale RFC review (open questions + fallback)
- 10m: mobile latency triage (logs + next steps)
- 5m: decision log updates + action owners

maya: who can own each? tagging folks who usually run these: @taylor (product), @devon (infra), @ellie (design)

 taylor: Thu 9am PT works for most of product team. i can own the rollout gating item but need devon to confirm infra constraints. :+1:

 devon: i can take the autoscale RFC slot. would like 5 extra mins if we need to show perf numbers. also can co-own the rollout gating notes with taylor.

 ellie: design review collides on Tue — Thu 9am is fine. i can present mobile latency UI telemetry and proposed ux changes.

 samir: oncall has a pager rotation on Thu mornings this month, might be noisy. i can join but prefer agenda owners to add a short async summary in the thread in case i have to drop.

 jana: SRE OK with Thu 9am, but pls ensure we surface canary rollback plan in the rollout doc. i'll add a short checklist to the RFC before the meeting.

 maya: thanks all. proposed owners: rollout gating = taylor+devon, autoscale RFC = devon, mobile latency = ellie, decision log = maya/jana. leaving 5m buffer for overruns.

 taylor: i'll prepare the rollout doc summary and add a 1-slide risk table. will drop a link and a quick TL;DR in this thread by EOD Wed.

 devon: posting perf numbers here tomorrow. snippet of the metrics i'll include:
```
95th latency: 120ms -> 98ms (opt)
cost per 1k tokens: $0.28 -> $0.22 (quant + batching)
```

 ellie: adding mobile telemetry screenshots to the drive, will put a short walking script for the 10m slot.

 maya: ok i'll update the calendar — moving to Thu 9am PT for next two weeks and invite crossfunc. calendar-bot: please create a placeholder with the agenda above and attach this thread.

 calendar-bot: Created event "Crossfunc roadmap + RFC review" Thu 09:00 PT — agenda attached. Attendees: maya, taylor, devon, ellie, samir, jana.

 maya: if anyone else needs to be added (engineering leads or PMs), reply here and i'll add them. otherwise see you Thu. :v:
